# Acceptance testing

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

A test that shows that a user story works as the customer expects. In Extreme Programming, the customer specifies the scenarios, each story has one or more acceptance tests, and a story is not complete until it passes them. Acceptance tests are black-box system tests, and they also serve as regression tests before a release.
